description: The publication change stream: what this site published, stamped with OUR publish time (first_published, kev_added, detection_added, remediation_added, first_sighted, chain_added, and the BOD 26-04 Table 1 input changes ssvc_changed, kev_due_changed, kev_triage_flag_changed, kev_notes_changed, which fire on value changes between snapshots; a timestamp refresh alone fires none). Pass since (YYYY-MM-DD, strictly-after) on the first call, then the returned next_cursor to continue. Optional cve scopes the stream to one CVE's change history. Events for withdrawn CVE ids are omitted.

cve.description: Scope to one CVE's change history, such as CVE-2024-3400

name: get_updates
